sentence: This project studies how human activity affects parrots and cetaceans, using direct observations, passive acoustic monitoring, and remote sensing.
This project builds a 3D safety sensor based on programmable 3D light curtains for human-robot collaboration.
This project studies how genetics and the environment decide whether a tropical tree has male flowers, female flowers, or both.
This project provides a cell sorter that separates cells into groups based on size and cell-surface markers.
This project develops electronics that combine ferroelectric materials with superconducting devices to control quantum computers.
This project builds deep neural networks that can analyze the shapes in images instead of mostly seeing textures.
This project develops mathematical methods to analyze twisted two-dimensional semiconductors and twisted bilayer graphene.
This project builds a system that lets drones use a large language model to understand mission goals and adapt to changing conditions.
This project tries to turn abandoned low-cost earphones into portable sensing devices.
This project studies how a long megadrought has changed soil moisture and carbon and water cycling in drylands.
This project works toward building a quantum computer and tackles obstacles such as developing algorithms and scaling up quantum technologies.
This project builds AI methods that report their own confidence when predicting how molecules bind to proteins.
This project brings researchers together each year to discuss how to combine computational modeling with experiments in cell and molecular biology.
This project builds a hands-on platform of experiments that shows how cyber-attacks and defenses work in vehicle electronics.
This project uses a high-throughput platform to find a T-cell receptor that can identify and destroy cancer cells.
This project develops a chip-scale technology that uses light to control light at low power.
